messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate on inference-api (service: inference-prod) originating from az1a. Spike started ~14:02Z. Observed packet loss between NLB and instance fleet, connection resets reported. Paging oncall.
jordan: paging @nina oncall — can you ack and triage?
nina: acked. pulling traces and kvcache metrics now. seeing increased retransmits on az1a.
raj: I'm seeing NIC tx qdisc drops and kernel econnreset on a subset of g5 hosts in az1a. probable host-level network degradation, not app bug. preparing an eviction window to drain bad hosts.
nina: plan: 1) steer traffic away from az1a to az1b 2) enable model-fallback (lighter quantized variant) for affected routes 3) warm caches in az1b. executing now.
raj: recommend immediate routing change and scale up capacity in az1b while we drain.
devops-bot: runbook invoked: runbook/inference/network-degrade -> step 2 (traffic-steer).
nina: running route update command to shift traffic (internal):
```
rctl route update --policy inference-global --from az1a --to az1b --weight 0.75 --reason "az1a nic packetloss"
```

jordan: i'll disable healthcheck probing from external monitors to reduce churn during drain.
raj: starting NLB target drain in az1a and marking problematic instances for reprovision. also kicking off packet capture on one host.
[logs snippet]
```
[14:02:31] inference-api az1a 502 conn-reset txdrops=120
[14:02:37] router controller az1a->az1b shift=40% ok
[14:02:46] nlb az1a draining target id=i-0abc123 status=DRAINING
```

nina: enabling fallback variant for text-generation routes to reduce per-request kernel pressure.
devops-bot: command executed: model-service set-variant --model text-gen-large --variant text-gen-compact --scope=route:/v1/generate --ttl=30m
jordan: KV cache bump to reduce token-level calls:
```
cachectl update --prefix "/inference/" --ttl 300
```

alex: support note: preliminary impact assessment — ~8% of production requests for embeddings in EU region hitting az1a returned 502/503 between 14:02-14:04Z. Retries reduced visible errors for most customers. preparing status page draft.
nina: paging sales + support with short blurb. no confirmed data loss; requests retried upstream. will monitor error rate and latency percentiles.
raj: scaling pool in az1b:
```
infractl scale pool --region az1b --pool inference-gpu --add 8 --instance-type g5.2xlarge
```

nina: traffic shift at 60% now. errors trending down to 2.1% in az1a-proxied requests. continuing drain of affected hosts.
lee: ack taking second-shift. i'll run tcpdump capture, check ENI metrics, and start a postmortem draft. ETA 35m for full remediation (all traffic back to normal or az1a quarantined).
jordan: handing off to @lee. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: severity upgraded to SEV2 — incident channel opened. runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/incidents/az-network-degrade/6512349876

nina: leaving a short customer-facing note for status page: "We are experiencing elevated errors for inference requests in one AWS availability zone. Traffic is being routed to healthy capacity; we are actively remediating and will provide updates. No customer data was lost."

alex: posted status update to #status and support loop.

lee: creating ticket and tagging eng-sre + infra for follow-up. will include packet captures and kernel logs in postmortem.

incident-bot: end of thread for handoff.
